build_alpha_zero_model: build an AlphaZero model with policy and value heads using flax.linen for game-playing agents
create_train_state: create a Flax TrainState with batch stats for tracking running statistics in batch normalization
run_inference: run inference on the AlphaZero model to get policy and value predictions for a given observation
update_model_weights: update model weights using policy and value loss with optional weight decay regularization
save_load_checkpoint: save and load model checkpoints using Orbax checkpointing for resuming training
